column1: # The known disagreements between this crate and the reference checker on
# damaged images (#164): scripts/differential-fuzz.sh fails on any class of
# disagreement not listed here. One class a line, tab-separated:
#   direction  structure  signature  note
# - direction: `ref-only` (the reference found something this crate called
#   clean) or `ours-only` (this crate found something the reference did not).
# - structure: what the case changed (`node`, `node-torn`, `jset`,
#   `superblock`, `key-<field>`, ...), or `*` for any.
# - signature: what was found, as the run's report prints it: the
#   reference's first finding with its numbers folded to `#` for ref-only,
#   this crate's finding for ours-only.
# - note: the issue that tracks it, or why it is not a defect.
# A line is added only from a measured run's report, never by guess. When a
# fix removes a class, its line goes in the same pull request.
# Measured at 034ded6 in CI run 38579070302, reference checker 1.39.7.
# 648 cases, eight clean controls: 97 reference-only cases in 46 classes.
# Each exact class below is an unresolved checker defect tracked by its issue.
# No wildcard entries; new classes, failed controls and crate panics still fail.
# #221's four inode-metadata classes were removed by #225 once a run at
# seed 0, 80 cases a fixture, no longer found them.
# #219's sixteen size and snapshot classes were removed by #226 once a run
# at seed 0, 80 cases a fixture, no longer found them.
# #219's six position, accounting and xattr-length classes were removed by
# #229 the same way.
# #219's snapshot_tree at offset U64_MAX, from nightly run 38878947701, is
# reported since the checker refuses a tree id past U32_MAX.
# #220's three snapshot-link classes were removed by #224 once a run at
# seed 0, 80 cases a fixture, no longer found them.
# #163's forty allocation and key-type classes were removed by #454 once
# main run 40754536244 (seed 0, 80 cases a fixture, fixtures of CI run
# 40744795974) no longer found them; the three it still found are at the
# end, each tracked by its own issue.
ref-only
column3: check_allocations...invalid bkey in btree_node btree=inodes level=#: u#s # type inode_v# #:u#_max le
column4: #219: metadata key invariants
